observations: I opened assets/panels/02-4.png. Ananya is seated at left, turned toward Meera, with an open-mouth smile. She has the bun, stud, stethoscope, and white coat over teal. Meera stands at right with a warm smile, eyes toward Ananya, braid over her left shoulder and blue kurta. Both match main-cast.png.

Ananya's right hand (image left) is raised in a small fist at her chest, in front of the stethoscope tubing without gripping it. Her left hand rests on the desk beside the laptop. Meera's right hand (bangle on that wrist) holds the phone at hip level; its screen shows a calendar icon and blocks with no text. Her left hand hangs at the bottom edge of the frame. This matches production.hands and the staff-phone heldBy meera.right.
The laptop screen faces the reader and shows only grey bars and a button, nothing readable. The scene and props record now say the screen is turned toward Meera and the reader, which matches the art.
The top-left hard-edged white rectangle is gone. The bookshelf now runs to the top edge.

Minor decor drift, not blocking: a blue curtain, a framed leaf print and a doorway to a reception area appear here. The window top is cropped, so a rolled-up blind as in 02-2 and 02-3 is not contradicted.
page-02.png: the balloon 'One team. Better coordination.' sits between the two figures, with its tail to Ananya's mouth side. It covers neither face nor the phone.
